props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical violins stand on a category axis; horizontal ones lie along a value axis, which suits long group names.

props.name: showBox
props.description: Draw a slim box plot inside each violin.

props.name: showPoints
props.description: Scatter the observations inside each violin, jittered within its width.

props.name: bandwidth
props.description: Multiplier on Silverman's bandwidth. Below 1 shows more bumps, above 1 smooths them.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Name of the measure, printed beside the value axis.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format values on the axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.
